meaning: An explicit application output layout is a path-and-receipt envelope around the unchanged checked reconciled TypeScript project, not an architectural, numeric or domain-semantic selection.
selection: The existing domainspec.application-layout/v1 output-layout option is supported for whole-project reconciled source/snapshot builds and currentness verification. Omission preserves exact old wrappers, receipts and paths. Unknown layouts, node-scoped application views, conflicting languages/numeric selections and authored graph compositions reject without fallback.
mapping: Prefix every original planned module path with domain/typescript/src/, retaining the authored module_root and complete existing profile-relative hierarchy. Prefix internal import target_path and any artifact module evidence paths by the same envelope; leave native source content, import specifiers, exported names, qualified identities, generator selections and source plan digests unchanged. Emit the exact receipt at evidence/project-build.json.
identity: The frozen view and output receipt bind the original view digest, existing output-layout identifier, this extension definition digest, complete mapped inventory and shared original project plan. A build wrapper records the extension only when explicitly selected. Never accept caller artifacts, forged plans, callbacks or receipt JSON as checked input.
integration: All source/snapshot build APIs, local publication and whole-project build/verify CLI paths use the same mapped view. Existing output publication/currentness machinery is reused with no legacy renderer. Native tests compile actual published modules and exercise the same compound domain consumer in two output roots.
safety: Reject an existing target without changing it. Existing exact regular-file, symlink, directory-inventory and stale-receipt checks apply to the mapped output. Publication cleanup remains scoped to its own staging. Concurrent-writer/no-replace qualification remains R09; do not claim it from this adapter.
non_effects: No generated source rewrite or second compiler
No source-model edits or implicit composition bindings
No generated provider or domain Operation execution during build
No native/formal verification by currentness receipt
No dependency installation, admission, release or external publication
